ledger.x: 1184: infobox 'Established: 1184'; 'after the death of Husamuddin Shuhli around 1174-75 or 1184-85, Shoja al-Din Khorshid became the independent lord of Lur-e-Kuchak'; infobox first ruler '1174/1184-1224'.
1395-96: 'Muhammad Sultan, governor of Fars, extended his authority over all of Luristan and Khuzestan.'
1405: Sidi Ahmad, son of Izz al-Din, 'regained his possessions after the death of Timur in 1405 and ruled until 1412-13 or 1422'.

Page silent on the year: Muhammadi 'submitted to Sultan Murad III, which earned him several territories west of Iran, including Mandali, Badra, Jassan, and Tursaq'; placed in 1578, the first year after Ismail II's death (November 1577), since the page puts the submission 'after the deaths of Shah Tahmasp and Shah…
1597: infobox 'Disestablished: 1597'; 'In 1597-98 Shah Abbas besieged and killed him in the fortress of Changuleh'; he 'gave the rest of Luristan to Husayn Khan Solvizi'.
1597: 'This marked the end of the Khorshidi dynasty'; infobox 'Disestablished: 1597'.

wars.name: Timurid conquest of Luristan
wars.outcome: 'When Timur arrived in Iran in 1386' the Timurids 'laid waste to Borujerd and razed the fortress of Khorramabad to the ground'; Izz al-Din 'was captured in 1388 in Rumiyan near Borujerd'; in 1393 Timur went 'from Borujerd to Shushtar' (Khorshidi page).

wars.name: Safavid conquest of Little Lorestan
wars.outcome: In 1593-94 Shahverdi killed Oghurlu Sultan Bayat, governor of Hamadan, in a pitched battle; in 1597-98 Shah Abbas besieged and killed him in the fortress of Changuleh and gave the rest of Luristan to Husayn Khan Solvizi (Khorshidi page).
